column1: # What enforces each requirement in this library's specs (0024-spec-format FR-011 - FR-014).
# mechanism: check | gate | review | none. by: "<repo>: <command>" for check and gate, the defining requirement for review, "-" for none.

column4: note
suite/layers.test.ts: every file of the real tree is in a unit and no import is outside its row
suite/layers.test.ts: verify runs every check of the library
suite/vocabulary.test.ts: every list has one registry entry for each case and each entry is a member of the ontology plan:, and a value outside a list is an error value
suite/fold.test.ts: an item of each kind has the fields of the core and the five states
suite/ids.test.ts: the smart constructors, the clock over the real merge clock of anyfs, the sight of an id and the refusal of a far-future id
suite/actors.test.ts: the actor rules in the types and in the constructors, from the values of a file and from a run's context
suite/events.test.ts: an event of each type, deeply frozen, with the refusals of makeEvent
suite/fold.test.ts: the fold is the same for any order and any repeat, the conflicts, the proposals and the authority of each field
suite/links.test.ts: a link that closes a cycle of blocks is refused with its items
suite/typing.test.ts: the governance and logical sources import no system module, read no clock and use no random source
suite/typing.test.ts: the sources hold no any, non-null assertion, enum or cast but brand, and the files that must not compile do not (ts-expect-error, held by the compiler of verify)
suite/external-ids.test.ts: the id of a ULID against its layout, the id of another scheme, and the actors of a file by the rule of the configuration
suite/records.test.ts: the files of events and items round-trip with their keys in order and decode totally, and the monorepo's three records round-trip as written
suite/reconcile.test.ts: an item seen in two places has a trace for each with the content last taken and the record as read
suite/reconcile.test.ts: the classes new, unchanged, updated and absent, and no event from an unchanged place, over generated places
suite/reconcile.test.ts: the match order anchor, external id, fingerprint, locator, a single match for an item, and the ids of a new item
suite/reconcile.test.ts: the three-way merge as events of a tool, the conflict value naming the three values, labels merged, parent of links
suite/reconcile.test.ts: a derived close, its reopening, and the person's event winning
suite/reconcile.test.ts: the history a place keeps is taken as it is, by union of ids, and an id with other content is a conflict
suite/patches.test.ts: proposals of same as in a fixed order, nothing merged, a linked pair not proposed again
suite/patches.test.ts: a patch around one event with the operation its type says, refused with no target
suite/patches.test.ts: the capability of each patch, append event, the outbox naming the capability and the entries offered again
suite/patches.test.ts: a dry run with no hash, the plan of the hash applied and any other hash refused
suite/views.test.ts: the query over items, events, links and traces, and proposals not counted unless told
suite/views.test.ts: the roadmap, the graph of blocks, the matrix of requirement by item and responsibility
suite/views.test.ts: the matrix of what a source holds with its findings, and Markdown and JSON5 saying what they cannot hold
suite/typing.test.ts: the governance and logical sources are pure and hold no any, non-null assertion, enum or cast but brand
suite/store.test.ts: one file for each event, total loading, the clock after every id and the union of two stores in any order
suite/sources.test.ts: defineSource and its refusals
suite/sources.test.ts and suite/markdown.test.ts: an explicit target, a dry run, a hash that is not the plan's refused, the outbox
suite/markdown.test.ts, comments.test.ts, issues.test.ts, event-files.test.ts: the laws of a lens over generated places, and a source that breaks them found
suite/sources.test.ts: the same source over memory, a folder and SQLite, and a write that finds the file changed a conflict
suite/issues.test.ts: the real issues folder of commons/data, every field kept, the barrel checked, the status replaced alone
suite/event-files.test.ts: made-up files of the monorepo's schema read, found, and written with the bytes kept; the comparison with the monorepo's fold is skipped and says why
suite/markdown.test.ts: the examples of the task list section of GFM, the marker rules, nesting, the one-character write
suite/comments.test.ts: the markers, the fingerprint that survives a move, the anchor, generated and vendored files
suite/sources.test.ts: a real temporary Git repository for the commits and a local fake of the host's client; no account, so the live client is left untested
suite/sources.test.ts: the reserved names, the matrix of every source, and a journal of the real Evidence Capture code that no source reads or changes
suite/planctl.test.ts: definePlanning, the one reader and the field it names for each wrong value
suite/planctl.test.ts: the principal by session, argument and configuration, and the refusal that says none is established
suite/planctl.test.ts: the verbs over a made-up repository in process and as a real process, the dry run, the hash and the check status
suite/planctl.test.ts: the tool server over its real transport with an agent and its principal, human-only options refused and an agent that cannot confirm
suite/planctl.test.ts: only the file at the root, JSON not read, a trust recorded by the person and lost when the file changes
suite/planctl.test.ts: planctl render prints the items in the formats and says what Markdown cannot hold
suite/poam.test.ts: a task's due day from the opening and from an edited event, the refusal on another kind, and an edit on a non-task that changes nothing
suite/poam.test.ts: due round-trips in JSON5 with its key in order, a non-day is an error value, and the matrix has a cell for due in every source
suite/poam.test.ts: the milestones of a finding are the tasks it is the parent of, and a not-planned one is not part of the plan
suite/poam.test.ts: the control labels of two regimes are kept as written in the row
suite/poam.test.ts: the rows, their order, the scheduled completion and the same rows for the items in any order
suite/poam.test.ts: the statuses open, delayed and completed of a milestone and of a finding, and what is not a milestone or a row
suite/poam.test.ts: the work orders by the label workload and the link relates-to, their status and order
suite/typing.test.ts: the logical sources import no system module, read no clock and hold no any, non-null assertion, enum or cast but brand
